skill.name: baoyu-gemini-web
skill.description: Generate Gemini Web text and images from prompts, prompt files, and optional attachments using a local Chrome login session.
skill.summary: Run Gemini Web from Claude, Codex, or Claude Code for text and image generation.
skill.author: JimLiu

security_audit.summary: The skill performs the advertised Gemini Web automation, but it captures and stores Google authentication cookies, launches Chrome, and sends prompts or files to Google endpoints. Most backtick detections are false positives from TypeScript templates or Markdown fences, while network, cookie, filesystem, and child-process risks remain confirmed. No prompt-injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Google session cookies are captured through Chrome DevTools and cached locally.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer an official API or scoped OAuth flow. If cookie login remains, isolate the account, encrypt storage where possible, and warn before login.

remediation.issue: Prompt files and attachments can send local file contents to Google services.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit file confirmation, path allowlists, size limits, and clear notices before any upload or prompt-file request.

remediation.issue: The Chrome executable path can be controlled through environment configuration.
remediation.suggestion: Validate the selected executable path, log the resolved path before launch, and require user confirmation for nonstandard browser paths.

remediation.issue: The implementation relies on undocumented Gemini Web endpoints.
remediation.suggestion: Document endpoint fragility, add graceful failure messages, and provide a supported API fallback for production workflows.

The skill combines external process launch, Chrome DevTools browser control, Google cookie capture, and authenticated network requests. The behavior is advertised, but the high-impact combination is real.
The skill reads local files, stores and loads Gemini cookies, and sends authenticated requests to Google endpoints. This creates a genuine credential and data exposure risk.

semantic_findings.title: Browser Automation Captures Google Session Cookies
semantic_findings.description: The Chrome login flow connects through Chrome DevTools, calls Network.getCookies for Gemini and Google domains, and returns the resulting cookie map for reuse. This exposes high-value Google session cookies inside the skill runtime.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly calls CDP Network.getCookies for Gemini and Google URLs, then writes the cookie map to disk with mode 0600.

semantic_findings.title: Local Files Can Be Sent To Google Services
semantic_findings.description: Prompt files and attachment paths are resolved from the local working directory, read into memory, and uploaded or embedded in Gemini requests. Users may expose local file contents if they pass sensitive paths.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The CLI reads prompt files from disk, and the client uploads file bytes to content-push.googleapis.com through FormData.

actual_capabilities: Runs text prompts through Gemini Web and returns plain text responses.
Generates images from prompts and saves the first available image to disk.
Reads prompt text from command arguments, standard input, or prompt files.
Authenticates by opening Chrome and caching Gemini cookies for later runs.
Supports Gemini web model selection with fallback to a flash model.
Can emit structured command output for downstream automation.
limitations: Requires access to Gemini Web through a Google account and a local Chrome-compatible browser.
Stores sensitive Gemini cookies locally or accepts them through environment variables.
Sends prompts, selected files, and image requests to Google services.
Relies on undocumented Gemini Web endpoints that may change without notice.

best_practices: Use a dedicated Google account with limited data exposure for Gemini Web automation.
Review prompt files and attachments before sending them to Gemini.
Store cookie files in a private directory with restrictive permissions.
anti_patterns: Do not use a primary personal Google account for unreviewed automation.
Do not send confidential files unless your policy allows Google processing.
Do not depend on Gemini Web endpoints for production-critical workflows without fallback plans.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Gemini API key?
faq.answer: No. It uses Gemini Web through a Chrome login session and cached cookies.

faq.question: Can it generate images?
faq.answer: Yes. It can ask Gemini Web for an image and save the first available image locally.

faq.question: Where are cookies stored?
faq.answer: By default, cookies are stored under the user data directory for baoyu-skills. The path can be overridden.

faq.question: Can it read prompt files?
faq.answer: Yes. Prompt files are read from disk and concatenated before the Gemini request.

faq.question: Does it send data outside my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. Prompts, selected files, cookies, and image requests are sent to Google services.

faq.question: Is it stable for long-term automation?
faq.answer: It depends on Gemini Web internals. Undocumented endpoints and cookie requirements can change.
